svg.title: Precast Segment Alignment, inside the one HTML file
svg.desc: The site engineer types the surveyed level difference of each new segment into the erection schedule. Every input reschedules render(), which runs solve() for the rotations, deviations and the shim plan, redraws the SVG graphs, updates the status bar and Site entry card, and saves the run to the browser's localStorage, from which the run is loaded again when the page opens. Export to PDF captures the drawn graphs and writes an A4 PDF with the page's own PDF writer. There is no server: everything runs in the browser. a surveyed segment: Site engineer → Erection schedule → render() → solve(), SVG graphs, Status bar, localStorage. a PDF report: SVG graphs → PDF writer → A4 PDF report.
